_note: One row per carrier. A carrier is a folder tools/carriers/<id>/ holding CARRIER.md (its own rules + change log), render.py (render(content, content_dir, out_path) -> None), gates.py (gates(out_path) -> list of (name, ok, detail)) and vendor/ (copies of upstream files, provenance below). build.py reads only this file to find a carrier; a folder without a row, or a row without a folder, fails `build.py selftest`. Retire a carrier by status, never by deleting its folder. Change a carrier = edit its folder, bump version, add a CARRIER.md change-log line, run `build.py selftest`.
